lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four primary horizontal tiers of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. The spatial density is highest in the region immediately posterior to the fifth branchial slit, with inter-centroid spacing increasing in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal axes of the blobs, forming a visible grid-like pattern of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature along the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition, with high-luminance values on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 6-10 high-luminance blobs is visible within the boundary of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily concentrated in the anterior-ventral quadrant.
